entry.note: 1 bare-URL Ref upgraded with title+author+year form. | UPDATE 2026-05-19 18:18: PDF in library/arxiv-1210.6243v1/1210.6243v1.pdf is Bach, Pope, Liou, Batelaan 'Controlled double-slit electron diffraction' (Phys. Rev. Lett./NJP 2013) — exact match.

relevance.rationale: Identity confirmed from the document's own cover (arXiv:1210.6243v1, controlled double-slit electron diffraction, four authors) and matches the seeded key; the ref() entry's venue/volume are consistent with the published form. Citation is load-bearing and the locators check out. Sites: (1) folio/bach2013-double-slit/double-slit-experiment/bach-intensity-profile.md:1 'digitized from Figure 3e' — VERIFIED: the document's figure 3 runs 3a-3e and line 132 of the extracted text reads 'In figure 3e the pattern ...', so the named sub-panel exists and is the accumulated-pattern panel a digitisation would use. (2) bach-single-electron-buildup.md:9 'Figure 3 shows the buildup' — VERIFIED (lines 76, 91, 130-132: single-electron accumulation across 3a-3d). (3) bach-introduction.md:8 credits the full realisation of the Feynman thought experiment — VERIFIED verbatim in the abstract. (4) folio/quantum-observable-universe/observations/double-slit-massive-pattern.md:48 and double-slit-intro.md:5 use it as the experimental comparison target for the q-corrected sinc^2 envelope, with double-slit-massive-pattern.lean:89 carrying the matching `-- Ref:`. One caution worth recording, not a citation defect: double-slit-intro.md:5 says the QOU anomalies 'match the Bach et al. 600 eV electron diffraction dataset'; a match against a digitised figure is a compute-check obligation, not an adoption, and no witness is named at either block.

keyResults.statement: The accumulated single-electron double-slit diffraction pattern for the controlled (movable-mask) geometry, from which an intensity profile can be digitised.
keyResults.useForFolio: It is the actual data source behind bach-intensity-profile; the folio's q-corrected sinc^2 envelope is compared against it.

proposedActions.rationale: double-slit-intro.md:5 asserts the q-deviation 'matches' this dataset but names no witness. The comparison of the q-corrected sinc^2 envelope against the digitised Fig. 3e profile should emit a witness so the claim is checkable; a visual match is not evidence and adopting a q-value that improves the fit would be a fit.
